senses.gloss:
रेणुः m. f.
1 Dust, an atom of
dust, sand &c.; तुरगखुरहतस्तथा हि
रेणुः Ś. 1. 32.
--2 The pollen of
flowers.
--Comp.
--रूषित a. soiled
with dust.
--(तः) an ass.
--वासः a
bee.
--सारः, --सारकः camphor.

1 The wife of Jamadagni
and mother of Paraśurāma; see
जमदग्नि.
--2 A kind of medicinal
substance.
